Islam is projected to overtake Christianity as the world's largest religion by 2035, according to new Pew Research Center projections. But what is driving this historic shift in global religious demographics?
Muslim women have an average of 3.1 children, compared with 2.5 among Christian women. By 2070, Muslims are projected to gain 1.6 billion people through natural population change, compared with 792 million for Christians.
